title: Engine adapter: Decider (decider-ai, 0.8B to 35B)
description: Apache-2.0, probabilities per option, MPS fp16 merged 2026-09-22, CPU and CUDA. Start with the 0.8B checkpoint.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Engine adapter: Decider answers a scored task

Scenario: Decider returns option probabilities the harness can score
  Given the Decider (decider-ai, Apache-2.0) 0.8B checkpoint installed via its device extra
  When I run bd run --engine decider on a committed task with the CPU, MPS and CUDA extras available
  Then it returns a probability per option for every item and studies/ records the answers in the same schema as the other engine adapters

right_now_summary: The Decider engine adapter is being added, starting with the 0.8B checkpoint and scored option probabilities.
